<agent_message from="peer-b" agent_id="ag_2515393e-0415-4071-9b6d-9082676e26cf" status="completed" program="qwen">
Not sufficient on its own. A raw input string is only a valid key if the string uniquely and permanently determines the result — in practice it doesn't, because the same input can legitimately map to different outputs across cache namespaces (algo/version, model or config params, locale/normalization, tenant/user scope, TTL-sensitive data). **Top risk: silent wrong-value hits** — a collision or stale-namespace match returns a cached result that looks correct but is not, and it degrades gradually rather than failing loudly. Minimum fix: hash the input into a fixed-size key and prefix it with the fields that change semantics (namespace + version + relevant params), plus normalize/size-limit the input so huge or whitespace/case-variant strings don't cause unbounded keys or spurious misses.
</agent_message>
